comment: Scripted games for cross-emulator differential testing (tools/diff_test.py). Player moves are key sequences; the AI reply is deterministic with FRAMES pinned to 0. Moves only need to pass the game's minimal validation (white source, non-white destination) - some are deliberately unorthodox to reach promotion/game-over quickly, and 'captures' includes a move that gets rejected (source captured by the AI) to exercise the input retry path. 'combined' walks one game through a genuine AI en-passant capture (the black d4 pawn's forward square is blocked, making the ep capture its best move), promotions on both sides, and a king-capture finish. 'rejects' exercises every get_move rejection path. 'longgame' is machine-generated (greedy captures-first policy vs the deterministic AI) for position coverage depth.
